verdict_reason: The exception rename is applied correctly and the new test is truthful, but dropped-connection handling is tested on only one of five MDM calls and its set-up is copied between test classes.

todos.issue: This PR wraps all five MDM calls in fromMdm so a dropped connection becomes MdmUnavailableException (MdmService.java:31,45,54,64,70), but only searchProducts has a test for it (MdmServiceTest.java:280). No test in the repo stubs a connection fault, so removing fromMdm from getPortsOfEntry, getCountries, getCommodities or getCommoditySpecies keeps every test green, and those four would stop answering 503 when MDM cannot be reached.
todos.fix: Must: each MDM call that fromMdm wraps has a test that fails if the wrapper is removed from that call. One way: a parameterised test over the four other calls, each stubbed to throw a RetryableException, asserting MdmUnavailableException with that cause.

todos.issue: The dropped-connection set-up is copied. MdmServiceTest.java:281-293 builds the same RetryableException (-1, 'connection reset', new RuntimeException('reset'), 0L, request) as MdmClientInterceptorTest.java:106-112, both added by this PR and differing only in HTTP method and request, and the Feign Request.create call it nests is also added at MdmErrorDecoderTest.java:40 and MdmClientInterceptorTest.java:143.
todos.fix: Must: one shared test helper builds a dropped Feign connection for a given HTTP method, and the PR's tests call it with no local copies. One way: a droppedConnection(Request.HttpMethod) method in a test-support class under src/test/java, which the extra per-call tests for the dropped-connection gap can use too.
